finding.claim: Unauthenticated tokens with unknown kid trigger an unthrottled outbound JWKS refetch per request.
finding.source: kid header of an unverified token, read at jwks_client.py:239-240 before signature verification
finding.sink: fetch_data() outbound HTTP to self.uri via get_signing_keys(refresh=True) at jwks_client.py:218 -> :168 -> :135
finding.guards_checked: kid used only for exact match (jwks_client.py:257); no URL built from kid; redirects blocked (:17-27, :131); scheme allowlist (:90-95). Missing: negative cache, minimum refresh interval, rate limit.

finding.claim: With cache_keys=True, keys removed from the JWKS remain trusted indefinitely because the per-kid lru_cache has no TTL.
finding.source: Precondition: IdP removes a compromised key from its JWKS; attacker holds that private key
finding.sink: Cached PyJWK returned by get_signing_key, then used for signature verification in api_jws.py:395-423

trace.note: get_signing_key wrapped in lru_cache with no TTL
first lookup caches PyJWK for kid
Tier-1 TTL does not apply to Tier-2 cache
later lookup returns stale cached key

finding.guards_checked: Documented trade-off in docstring (jwks_client.py:57-63). Eviction only at max_cached_keys (default 16) or process restart. No revocation check.

finding.claim: A single malformed JWKS entry raises non-PyJWT exceptions that abort parsing of the whole key set.
finding.source: Untrusted or compromised JWKS entry, e.g. alg 'none', oct key without 'k', or non-string alg
finding.sink: Uncaught NotImplementedError/KeyError/TypeError propagating out of PyJWKSet construction and get_signing_keys

trace.note: PyJWKSet loop catches only PyJWTError, so the exception escapes

finding.guards_checked: PyJWKSet catches PyJWTError (api_jwk.py:153) and skips unusable keys, but does not catch builtin exceptions. JWKS is treated as trusted input by design.

finding.claim: Malformed exp/iat/nbf claims raise TypeError or OverflowError instead of InvalidTokenError.
finding.source: Payload claim exp/iat/nbf set to null, array, object or Infinity
finding.sink: int(payload[...]) in _validate_exp, _validate_iat, _validate_nbf; only ValueError is caught

trace.note: int(payload['exp']) raises TypeError for null or list, OverflowError for inf

finding.guards_checked: Expiry is still enforced for all values the handlers accept. Reaching this path with an unverified payload requires verify_signature=False together with explicit verify_exp=True.

finding.claim: The PyJWS(algorithms=...) instance allowlist is not enforced when verifying with a PyJWK key.
finding.source: Caller-supplied algorithms list plus a PyJWK whose algorithm is excluded from the instance allowlist
finding.sink: key.Algorithm used for verification at api_jws.py:416-423, bypassing self._algorithms and self._valid_algs

trace.note: instance allowlist applied only to self._algorithms
alg_obj = key.Algorithm, instance allowlist not consulted

finding.guards_checked: Exact alg match with key.algorithm_name (api_jws.py:411-415). Caller-supplied algorithms list. Requires developer to rely on instance allowlist as a control.

finding.claim: Short HMAC secrets are accepted by default with only a warning, enabling offline brute force of captured tokens.
finding.source: Application configuration: short HMAC secret used for HS256/384/512
finding.sink: HMAC signing/verification with a weak secret; forged tokens after offline cracking

trace.note: length check result only warns unless enforced
same warn-only behaviour on decode path
check_key_length returns message when below digest size

finding.guards_checked: Warning emitted (InsecureKeyLengthWarning). Option available to enforce minimum length but off by default.

finding.claim: ECDSA verification accepts high-S signatures, so one signed payload has multiple valid token strings.
finding.source: Holder of a valid ES256/ES384/ES512 token modifies s to n-s

trace.note: public_key.verify accepts both s and n-s

finding.guards_checked: Signature length check (utils.py:87). No low-S enforcement. Matters only if the app keys replay, deny-list, or dedup on the raw token string.
